entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 3 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Dragonlords channel the might of dragons into their attacks, striking 3 targets at once. Applies a stack of Draconic Patience for 20 seconds, increasing Outgoing Damage by 3%, up to 10 stacks.

entries.target: An infinite range attack that deals damage to 3 hostile targets.
entries.officialDescription: Draw upon the destructive power of dragons to blast 3 targets with a powerful attack. Your fury applies Draconic Rage for 8 seconds, increasing your Outgoing Physical Damage by 15%.

entries.target: An long range skill that heals yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Tap into the regenerative power of dragons to protect yourself, healing HP and regaining 45 Mana. Also applies Draconic Bulwark for 5 seconds, reducing Incoming Damage by 20% but prevents you from gaining Draconic Rage for the same time.
notes: If used out of combat, while you don't already have a pet equipped, will summon Fabled Baby Dragon.
If Draconic Rage is in effect, consumes it (with no additional effects).
